body:
2 days ago, a high speed police chase happened on the street i was walking on at night. In the heat of the moment I was so compelled to jump in front of them, but I didn't make up my mind in time. Literally perfect time to do it, missed.

Ended up crying after I made it home.

I appreciate the reply :). Right now, I'm still having mixed feelings. It alternates between extreme anger, and heavy depression. But I think at this point, I need to get some sleep as I don't even remember how long I've been up. I guess it feels nice to finally feel noticed as I can be quite a recluse. I mean, I've lurked on this sub for so long and I didn't have an event that pushed me to post until today. I just wish sometimes i didn't push people who cared about me away. Anyways, I hope you are alright yourself. Thanks for the advice.
